+
+
 def normalize_email(value: str) -> str:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("expected a string")
+
+    # Strip outer whitespace
+    stripped = value.strip()
+
+    # Require exactly one @
+    if stripped.count("@") != 1:
+        raise ValueError("email must contain exactly one '@'")
+
+    local, domain = stripped.split("@")
+
+    if not local:
+        raise ValueError("empty local part")
+    if not domain:
+        raise ValueError("empty domain")
+
+    # Reject internal whitespace
+    if re.search(r"\s", stripped):
+        raise ValueError("internal whitespace not allowed")
+
+    return f"{local.lower()}@{domain.lower()}"

diff --git a/utility_pack/parse_size.py b/utility_pack/parse_size.py
index 8b488ca..9de66ef 100644
--- a/utility_pack/parse_size.py
+++ b/utility_pack/parse_size.py
@@ -1,2 +1,44 @@
+import re
+
+
 def parse_size(value: str) -> int:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("expected a string")
+
+    stripped = value.strip()
+
+    if not stripped:
+        raise ValueError("empty string")
+
+    # Check for internal whitespace
+    if re.search(r"\s", stripped):
+        raise ValueError("internal whitespace not allowed")
+
+    # Match pattern: optional negative sign, digits, optional decimal, unit
+    # Units: B, KB, MB, GB (case-insensitive)
+    match = re.match(r"^(-?\d+)(\.\d+)?\s*(B|KB|MB|GB)$", stripped, re.IGNORECASE)
+    if not match:
+        raise ValueError("invalid size format")
+
+    num_str = match.group(1)
+    decimal_str = match.group(2)
+    unit = match.group(3).upper()
+
+    # Reject negative values
+    if num_str.startswith("-"):
+        raise ValueError("negative values not allowed")
+
+    # Reject decimal values
+    if decimal_str:
+        raise ValueError("decimal values not allowed")
+
+    amount = int(num_str)
+
+    multipliers = {
+        "B": 1,
+        "KB": 1024,
+        "MB": 1024**2,
+        "GB": 1024**3,
+    }
+
+    return amount * multipliers[unit]
\ No newline at end of file

+import re
+
+
 def redact_token(value: str) -> str:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("expected a string")
+
+    # sk- followed by at least 20 ASCII letters or digits
+    value = re.sub(r"sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}", "[REDACTED]", value)
+
+    # ghp_ followed by at least 20 ASCII letters or digits
+    value = re.sub(r"ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}", "[REDACTED]", value)
+
+    # Bearer followed by at least 20 characters from letters, digits, ., _, /, +, =, or -
+    value = re.sub(r"Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._/+= -]{20,}", "[REDACTED]", value)
+
+    return value

 def retry_delay(attempt: int, base: float = 0.25, cap: float = 8.0) -> float:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int):
+        raise TypeError("attempt must be a nonnegative integer")
+
+    if attempt < 0:
+        raise ValueError("attempt must be a nonnegative integer")
+
+    if not isinstance(base, (int, float)) or base <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("base must be a positive finite number")
+
+    if not isinstance(cap, (int, float)) or cap <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("cap must be a positive finite number")
+
+    if base > cap:
+        raise ValueError("base must not be greater than cap")
+
+    return min(base * 2**attempt, cap)

--- a/utility_pack/slugify.py
+++ b/utility_pack/slugify.py
@@ -1,2 +1,24 @@
+import re
+import unicodedata
+
+
 def slugify(value: str) -> str:
-    raise NotImplementedError
\ No newline at end of file
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("expected a string")
+
+    # Normalize Unicode with NFKD
+    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value)
+
+    # Remove non-ASCII code points after normalization
+    ascii_bytes = normalized.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
+
+    # Convert to lowercase
+    lower = ascii_bytes.lower()
+
+    # Replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen
+    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", lower)
+
+    # Remove leading and trailing hyphens
+    slug = slug.strip("-")
+
+    return slug
\ No newline at end of file
